messages:
maria: heads up — Telescope Retail just paused their pilot. CISO requires BYO KMS attestation + SAML provisioning + a capped spend for the pilot quarter. they want an exec touchpoint tomorrow. can we pull people together?

derek: can you share the exact ask? attestation language or evidence they can sign off on?

maria: excerpt: 'vendor must provide attest that customer keys are only wrapped, never persisted; provide HSM signing metadata and key import audit trail; support SAML+SCIM and log forwarding to our Splunk instance.' full Q: https://drive.internal/telescope/sec-qna

trina: security/ops note — we can do SAML + SCIM for hosted and Dedicated. BYOK import available for Private. we can produce a provisional attestation (templated) and follow up with formal attestation after validation. ETA for full attestation: 3 business days post-deployment.

leo: infra ask — need allowlist CIDRs, expected peak tokens/sec, and whether they require peering or VPN. we'll also need an SIEM endpoint if they want log forwarding.

maria: they're asking for a spend cap of $60k for the quarter and a 25% POC discount. any flexibility?

sasha: commercial — propose $60k credit and 15% introductory discount for 90 days; anything >15% needs revenue lead approval. can offer pause option in SOW.

derek: ops can draft provisional attestation tonight with placeholders (HSM serial, import events). present that on the exec bridge and commit to formal attestation after private validation.

rev-bot: provisional-attestation created -> https://ops.internal/attestations/telescope-provisional (auto) :white_check_mark:

maria: plan: exec bridge tomorrow 09:30 PT. attendees: maria (AE), trina (security), leo (infra), sasha (rev), telescope CISO + VP eng. pre-brief 08:45 PT.

maria: owners: trina -> provisional attestation + talking points, leo -> network checklist, sasha -> pricing term sheet, derek -> deployment timeline. target: prep artifacts in pre-read 60m before pre-brief.

sasha: tagging revenue lead @vic — please approve credit up to $60k and the 15% pilot discount for bridge.

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen after pre-brief.
